code_refs.description: Replace (default) / Append variants for description update mode.
Computes previous_description and final text per DescriptionUpdateMode; replace/append branch at L627-636.
Unconditionally writes previous_description to DESCRIPTION_HISTORY_KEY in the history snapshot whenever description.is_some(), regardless of mode.
Reads DESCRIPTION_HISTORY_KEY from history fields and restores description.md on undo.
MCP input field: replace|append, default replace.
Parses description_mode into DescriptionUpdateMode, rejects unknown values as invalid_params.
Parses --description-mode and passes DescriptionUpdateMode into store.update_with_options.
